ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Claude key for chat, agent mode, the app builder and automations (from console.anthropic.com). Enter at least one key.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI key for GPT, images, voice and Sora video (optional if you entered a Claude key).

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Google key for Gemini and Veo video (optional).
